name: Rogue Mode
author: OpenFF
description: FF3 as a run-based roguelite: from the title, four heroes take jobs within a budget and fight through three acts of FF3's own monsters - elites every few battles, an FF3 boss at each act's end - choosing a reward after every victory: equipment, spells, passive modifiers that bend FF3's battle, gil, rest. A wipe ends the run. FF3's battle stays FF3's battle; the run is made of the engine's API and its battle events.
